tool_schemas.name: execute_sql
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL statement on the specified AnalyticDB for MySQL connection and returns an execution record (including an execution_id) plus results according to result_format (inline_json up to max_rows, an external_ref, or none). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id/connection_id do not match the required patterns, if required fields are missing, if max_rows is negative, or if result_format is not one of the supported values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to run queries for the given project/connection or attempts a non-read-only statement while readonly=true. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project_id or connection_id does not exist (or does not belong to the project) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller or project has exceeded allowed execution limits.

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the execution.

connection_id.description: Database connection identifier to run the SQL against.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

result_format.description: How to return results: inline JSON, external reference, or no results.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return for result-producing statements.

readonly.description: Whether to enforce read-only execution for this request.

tool_schemas.name: get_query_plan
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns the estimated optimizer query plan for the provided SQL text against the specified connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id/connection_id do not match the required patterns or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the given project/connection. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project_id or connection_id does not exist (or does not belong to the project) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when plan-generation requests exceed the allowed limits.

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the query.

connection_id.description: Database connection identifier to generate the plan against.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

sql_text.description: SQL statement text to explain (estimated optimizer plan).

tool_schemas.name: get_execution_plan
tool_schemas.description: Returns the actual execution plan and runtime execution statistics for a previously submitted query identified by execution_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id/execution_id do not match the required patterns or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view executions in the given project. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project_id or execution_id does not exist or the execution_id does not belong to the project, and CONFLICT if the execution has not produced an execution plan yet (for example, it is still running or has not reached a state where runtime statistics are available).

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the execution.

execution_id.description: SQL execution identifier to fetch the actual execution plan and runtime statistics for.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

tool_schemas.name: get_caller_identity
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates the provided api_key and returns the calling identity, resolved project, effective connection, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid or revoked; refuses FORBIDDEN if the resolved project is not active or no effective connection can be resolved (allowed_connection_id or default_connection_id). On success updates api_keys.last_used_at.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_sql_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists SQL execution records for a project, optionally filtered by connection, status, statement_type, tool_name, or time range. Returns a paginated page of executions ordered by requested_at desc. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted for the project or project is not active.

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the executions.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

connection_id.description: Filter to a specific database connection.

api_key_id.description: Filter to executions created under a specific API key id.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool that created the execution record.

requested_after.description: Only include executions requested at or after this time (RFC3339).

requested_before.description: Only include executions requested before this time (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_sql_execution
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single SQL execution record by execution_id, including any recorded query_plan_text, execution_plan_text, runtime_stats, and result references. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the project or project is not active; NOT_FOUND if the execution does not exist in the project.

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the execution.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_sql_execution
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an in-flight SQL execution. Transitions status queued->cancelled or running->cancelled when supported by the underlying engine; refuses CONFLICT if the execution is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled). Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the project or project is not active; NOT_FOUND if the execution does not exist.

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the execution.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for audit/logging.

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects visible to the caller API key. Returns a paginated list and refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid or revoked. Suspended or deleted projects may be returned for visibility but are not usable for query execution.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: list_db_connections
tool_schemas.description: Lists database connections for a project that the caller is allowed to use. If the API key is restricted with allowed_connection_id, only that connection is returned. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the project is not active or the caller cannot access the project.

project_id.description: Project identifier that owns the connections.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call.
